# ePlus Emoji

> Open, searchable emoji directory with browser-based Emoji Kitchen, editor, and sheet-cutting tools for developers, communities, and AI agents.

Canonical site: https://emoji.eplus.dev
Repository: https://github.com/vietnam-awesome/emoji

## Primary resources

- Home: https://emoji.eplus.dev/
- Browse all emoji: https://emoji.eplus.dev/emojis
- Browse categories: https://emoji.eplus.dev/categories
- Category landing page pattern: https://emoji.eplus.dev/categories/{category-slug}
- Emoji detail page pattern: https://emoji.eplus.dev/emoji/{slug}
- Emoji Kitchen: https://emoji.eplus.dev/kitchen
- Emoji editor: https://emoji.eplus.dev/editor
- Emoji Sheet Cutter: https://emoji.eplus.dev/cutter
- Static search manifest: https://emoji.eplus.dev/search/manifest.json
- Sitemap: https://emoji.eplus.dev/sitemap.xml
- Static routes sitemap: https://emoji.eplus.dev/sitemap-static.xml
- Agent guide: https://emoji.eplus.dev/agents.md

The removed legacy `/api/emojis.json` and `/api/categories.json` endpoints are not public discovery APIs and should not be used.

## Emoji Kitchen

The `/kitchen` route is a client-side Unicode emoji mashup tool. Users choose two emoji ingredients, search or explore combinations, swap/randomize them, and select a composition style such as Auto, Mash together, Wear / top, Corner badge, Side by side, Surround, Inside, or Repeat pattern.

Cooked output is rendered locally with the browser/device emoji font and Canvas. Users can choose transparent/light/dark backgrounds, export 512×512 PNG or WebP, copy PNG when supported, copy a shareable recipe URL, and continue editing the cooked result in `/editor` through same-tab browser session storage.

Emoji Kitchen does not remix the site's third-party catalog artwork and should not be described as Google Emoji Kitchen or as hosting Emoji Kitchen artwork.

## Emoji editor

The `/editor` route is a client-side emoji/image editor. It can open catalog emoji, receive cooked PNG output from `/kitchen`, or accept user-provided PNG, WebP, JPG, GIF, and SVG files.

Supported editing includes crop/fit/fill, repositioning, square resize presets, rotation, flipping, padding, background changes, PNG/WebP export, and animated GIF editing. Animated GIF tools include play/pause, frame scrubbing, include/exclude, duplicate/delete, per-frame delay, global speed adjustment, and browser-side GIF re-encoding.

Source images are processed locally in the browser rather than uploaded to a server for editing.

Deferred capabilities such as APNG frame-by-frame editing, interpolation, AI-generated in-between frames, onion skin, and arbitrary non-square output should not be assumed.

## Emoji Sheet Cutter

The `/cutter` route is a client-side tool for extracting individual emoji PNGs from larger emoji sheets or image collages. Users can start from built-in/shared library sheets published from the repository `data` branch, upload multiple local sheets, or paste an image from the clipboard. They can draw manual crop rectangles, optionally lock crops to a square, use a row/column grid guide, zoom for precision, and save multiple crops in one session.

Saved crops can keep their original dimensions or be normalized to 64, 128, 256, or 512 square PNGs. Users can copy or download each crop, download all crops as a browser-generated ZIP, or continue editing a crop in `/editor` through same-tab session storage.

Source sheets and crop processing stay in the browser; `/cutter` does not require uploading the source image to an ePlus Emoji server.

## Discovery guidance

Use `/emojis` for human-readable search/filtering, `/categories` for category discovery, `/categories/{category-slug}` for category overviews, and `/emoji/{slug}` for individual emoji details and hosted assets.

Use `/kitchen` when the task is to combine standard Unicode emoji into a new mashup. Use `/cutter` when the task is to manually extract individual emoji from a larger sheet or collage. Use `/editor` when the task involves transforming an emoji, editing an animated GIF, or refining a result from `/kitchen` or `/cutter`.

For the build-generated search index, start from `/search/manifest.json` and follow the current manifest/shard references instead of hard-coding generated shard filenames.

## Rights and attribution

Artwork can come from multiple upstream sources and may have different licensing terms. Do not infer redistribution rights from the directory alone. Check the relevant emoji detail/source metadata before reuse or redistribution. Emoji Kitchen intentionally uses the user's browser/device Unicode emoji rendering rather than deriving new artwork from catalog assets.
